key_insight: OpenSearch-VL is an end-to-end, fully open recipe (data, trajectory synthesis pipeline, and training details) that makes it possible to reproducibly train multimodal deep-search agents capable of active search, evidence verification, and multi-step reasoning.
problem_solved: Top-tier multimodal search agents are hard to reproduce because of missing open high-quality training data, opaque trajectory synthesis pipelines, and absent or incomplete training recipes.
method: Release a complete open-source pipeline: curated training data, automated trajectory synthesis for multi-step search tasks, and the full training recipe.
Train multimodal agents with supervision that combines active search actions, evidence verification steps, and chained reasoning to solve complex queries.
Provide reproducible code and evaluation harness to benchmark and iterate on agent behavior across multimodal search scenarios.
impact: By unlocking data, pipelines, and recipes, OpenSearch-VL lowers the barrier to reproducing and extending frontier multimodal search agents—accelerating research, comparison, and real-world deployment of agents that can search and verify multimodal evidence.

paper_title: OpenSearch-VL: An Open Recipe for Frontier Multimodal Search Agents
paper_authors: Shuang Chen, Kaituo Feng, Hangting Chen, Wenxuan Huang, Dasen Dai
